Based on the search results, here's what I found about ramen options in the Fenway area of Boston:

## Ramen Restaurants in Fenway

Hakata Ramen brings Japan's most classic ramen style to Back Bay with fresh ingredients, authentic recipes, and a menu full of mouthwatering dishes.

Ms. Cluck's Deluxe Chicken & Dumplings, located inside Fenway's Time Out Market, specializes in all things chicken and makes a stellar ramen that tastes like a homemade chicken soup, featuring chicken two-ways, ground on top with hot Asian chiles and incorporated into the dumplings as meatballs.

The "funky chicken" ramen at Hojoko has been a staple on the menu since chef Tim Cushman's rollicking izakaya first amped up the Fenway dining scene in 2015. The umami, koji-marinated chicken highlights the kitchen's robata-grill program, and the broth is light, fragrant, and deeply satisfying.

Kenzoku Mazesoba on Park Drive is within easy reach of students, local residents, and visitors exploring the Fenway area.

REDWHITE BONELESS RAMEN is led by Chef Kei with 15+ years of expertise and serves bold Japanese dishes with plant-forward creations.
